title: Cosmic Frog and Egg Castle
description: A surreal fantasy scene features a giant cracked egg with a castle built on top, positioned centrally on a tiled ground surrounded by large flowers and three winged angelic figures in purple robes. Above floats a green frog with purple eyes encircled by a swirling blue and purple cosmic ring, accompanied by an orange fish-like creature and falling petals, all set against a starry sky with a large red sun.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of a giant cracked white egg with a medieval castle built into it, sitting on ornate tiled ground surrounded by large peonies and three winged angels in purple robes holding staffs. Above, a green frog with purple eyes floats inside a swirling blue and purple cosmic ring, next to an orange fish-dragon creature, with flower petals falling. Red sun and constellations in a dark starry sky, mystical atmosphere.
